raw_text: Bangladesh Border Guard fires warning shots as fresh Rohingya refugee wave hits Cox's Bazar. Myanmar military-Arakan Army clashes in northern Rakhine driving displacement. Estimates of 500+ attempting border crossing. India's BSF and intelligence agencies on alert for potential secondary influx into Tripura via Chittagong Hill Tracts route.
